product.name: Wizard AI Shopping Agent
product.description: An AI-powered shopping assistant that enables users to search, find, and purchase products via text messaging.

product.name: Superpowered Search
product.description: A product search tool that scans millions of products, reviews, and editorials to find relevant items for users.

product.name: Conversational Shopping
product.description: An interactive AI agent that assists users in finding products through a conversational text interface.

product.name: Visual Shopping
product.description: A service that allows users to find products by submitting photos or screenshots via text.

product.name: Superpowered Checkout
product.description: A unified checkout system that allows users to order products from multiple brands with a single tap via text messaging.
